description: This file defines a Spring component class 'ProductToGLAccountMappingHelper' that manages the creation, updating, validation, and deletion of product-to-general-ledger account mappings within the Fineract accounting module. It includes methods for handling account mappings related to products, charges, classifications, payment channels, and reasons, with validation logic for ensuring referential integrity. It distinguishes itself through customized handling of different account types, mapping scenarios, and validation rules specific to the accounting logic for loans and products.

classes.name: ProductToGLAccountMappingHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing mappings between products and GL accounts, including creation, update, validation, and deletion operations, as well as handling related account validation and mapping specific to loan and product accounting scenarios.

methods.name: saveProductToAccountMapping
methods.description: Creates and saves a new product-to-GL account mapping based on JSON input, product ID, account type, and product type.

methods.name: mergeProductToAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges updates to existing product-to-GL account mappings based on JSON input, updating accounts if necessary.

methods.name: createOrmergeProductToAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Creates or merges product-to-GL account mappings, updating the changes map accordingly.

methods.name: savePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Saves mappings between payment channels and fund source accounts for a product.

methods.name: saveChargesToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Associates charges with income or expense GL accounts for a product.

methods.name: saveReasonToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Associates reasons with expense GL accounts for a product, based on reasons and account IDs from JSON.

methods.name: saveClassificationToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Associates classifications with income GL accounts.

methods.name: updateChargeToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates or deletes existing charge to income account mappings based on JSON input.

methods.name: updatePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Updates or deletes payment channel to fund source mappings based on JSON input.

methods.name: updateReasonToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates or deletes reason to expense account mappings based on JSON input.

methods.name: updateClassificationToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates or deletes classification to income account mappings.

methods.name: deleteProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Deletes a product to GL account mapping by product ID and account type.

methods.name: validateWriteOffMappingsInDatabase
methods.description: Validates write-off reasons exist in the database.

methods.name: validateGLAccountInDatabase
methods.description: Validates that provided GL accounts exist and are of the correct type.

methods.name: validateChargeOffMappingsInDatabase
methods.description: Validates charge-off reasons exist in the database.

methods.name: validateClassificationMappingsInDatabase
methods.description: Validates classification mappings exist and are valid in the database.

methods.name: getAccountByIdAndType
methods.description: Fetches a GL account by ID, ensuring it matches the expected account type, throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: getAccountById
methods.description: Fetches a GL account by ID without type validation.

methods.name: getAccountByIdAndType
methods.description: Fetches a GL account by ID, validating the account type against a list of acceptable types.

methods.name: deleteProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Deletes a product-to-GL account mapping by product ID and account type.

methods.name: deleteProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Deletes all product-to-GL account mappings for a product based on product ID and product type.
